The Idea

You leave the city
at the door.

Hải Châu doesn't slow down. Horns, heat, the constant forward motion of a city that never quite stops. Hideaway is the one room that opts out of it.

We built it around a single glass wall. On one side, a reformer and your fifty minutes. On the other, a private garden that has no idea what day it is. You come in wound up. You leave loose.

No membership pressure, no wellness lecture, no upsell. Just good equipment, small classes, and a space designed to make you exhale the moment you find it.

Two ways to move with us — a class with a handful of others, or the whole studio to yourself.

Good to Know

Before you find us

Yes — most people's first-ever reformer class happens in a room like this. With a maximum of four people, the instructor sets you up on the machine, walks you through the springs, and adjusts everything to your level. Arrive five minutes early for your first visit.

Comfortable clothes you can move in and grip socks — they're required on the equipment. Everything else is on us: the machines are set up and cleaned before every class, and water is available in the studio.

Everything runs through our online booking — hit any Book button on this page, pick your time, and your spot is reserved. With only four reformers per class, booking ahead is the way to guarantee your place.

Buy a pack, then book classes against it whenever suits you. The 5-pack is valid for 1 month, the 10-pack for 2 months, and the 20-pack for 4 months. Packs are per person and non-transferable.

Privates are exclusive to Hideaway and use the full apparatus — Cadillac, barrel and ladder — not just the reformer. It's one-to-one, built around your body and goals. Message us on Instagram to arrange a time.
